organisations_invest_range.name: organisations_invest_range
organisations_invest_range.value: "organisations"."invest_min" is null or "organisations"."invest_max" is null or "organisations"."invest_min" <= "organisations"."invest_max"

conversations_read_members.name: conversations_read_members
conversations_read_members.using: exists (select 1 from "organisation_members" m where m.user_id = (select auth.uid()) and m.org_id in ("conversations"."org_a_id", "conversations"."org_b_id"))

messages_read_members.name: messages_read_members
messages_read_members.using: exists (select 1 from "conversations" c join "organisation_members" m on m.org_id in (c.org_a_id, c.org_b_id) where c.id = "messages"."conversation_id" and m.user_id = (select auth.uid()))

partnerships_active_needs_both.name: partnerships_active_needs_both
partnerships_active_needs_both.value: "partnerships"."status" <> 'active' or ("partnerships"."owner_confirmed_at" is not null and "partnerships"."partner_confirmed_at" is not null)

funding_offers_amount_range.name: funding_offers_amount_range
funding_offers_amount_range.value: "funding_offers"."amount_min" is null or "funding_offers"."amount_max" is null or "funding_offers"."amount_min" <= "funding_offers"."amount_max"
